target.title: fix(azure-speech): add timeout to voices list request
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Azure Speech voice discovery could wait indefinitely when the voices endpoint accepts the HTTP connection but never returns a response.

## Why This Change Was Made

The `listAzureSpeechVoices` helper accepts an optional `timeoutMs`, but the provider only passes `config?.timeoutMs`. When no timeout is configured, the guarded request is unbounded. This change adds the same 30 second default already used by Microsoft, ElevenLabs, and Inworld voice list discovery.

## User Impact

Voice listing for Azure Speech now fails boundedly instead of hanging forever when the upstream stalls.

## Evidence

- Added mock-based regression tests in `extensions/azure-speech/voices-timeout-default.test.ts` that verify the default timeout is 30s and that explicit timeouts are preserved.
- Added live timeout proof in `extensions/azure-speech/voices-timeout.test.ts` using a local `node:http` loopback server that accepts the connection but never responds; the test stubs `globalThis.fetch` to redirect the guarded request to `127.0.0.1` and asserts `listAzureSpeechVoices({ ..., timeoutMs: 250 })` rejects with an abort/timeout error within 2 seconds.
- Ran `./node_modules/.bin/vitest run extensions/azure-speech/voices-timeout.test.ts extensions/azure-speech/tts.test.ts extensions/azure-speech/speech-provider.test.ts` — all pass.
- Ran `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt` and `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint` on the changed files — passed.

## Real behavior proof

A local `node:http` server on `127.0.0.1:0` accepts the request and leaves the socket open. The live test (`extensions/azure-speech/voices-timeout.test.ts`) routes the guarded `fetchWithSsrFGuard` call through `globalThis.fetch` to that server, then calls `listAzureSpeechVoices({ apiKey: "speech-key", baseUrl: "https://custom.example.com", timeoutMs: 250 })`. The call rejects within ~270 ms with an `aborted`/`timeout` error, well under the 2 second harness limit.

Command after this patch:
```
./node_modules/.bin/vitest run extensions/azure-speech/voices-timeout.test.ts
```
Result:
```
✓ |extensions| .../voices-timeout.test.ts > listAzureSpeechVoices live timeout > aborts a hanging voice list request within the configured timeout 270ms
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  1 passed (1)
```

What was not tested: live production Azure Speech traffic; the loopback harness proves the abort path behaves correctly without relying on a real third-party stall.
